#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Task {
public:
    int mod = 998244353;
    vector<vector<int>> stirlingCache;

    int add(int a, int b) {
        int c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) return c - mod;
        if (c < 0) return c + mod;
        return c;
    }

    int mult(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long long)a * b % mod);
    }

    int mult(int a, int b, int c) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), c);
    }

    int mult(const vector<int>& x) {
        int result = 1;
        for (int val : x) {
            result = mult(result, val);
        }
        return result;
    }

    void generateStirling() {
        stirlingCache.assign(5001, vector<int>(5001, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 5001; i++) {
            stirlingCache[i][0] = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 5001; i++) {
            stirlingCache[i][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i < 5001; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                stirlingCache[i][j] = add(mult(stirlingCache[i - 1][j], i - 1), stirlingCache[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    void runAlgorithm() {
        generateStirling();
        int n, m, k;
        cin >> n >> m >> k;
        long long invM = 1;
        long long base = m;
        long long modLL = mod;
        // Compute modular inverse of m mod mod
        // Using Fermat's little theorem since mod is prime
        invM = pow_mod(m, mod - 2, mod);
        vector<int> pValues(k + 1, 0);
        pValues[0] = 1;
        int currentN = n;
        int accumulatedProduct = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            accumulatedProduct = mult(accumulatedProduct, currentN, (int)invM);
            currentN--;
            int total = accumulatedProduct;
            for (int j = i - 1; j >= 1; j--) {
                int signFlag = ((i - j) % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
                total = add(total, mult(stirlingCache[i][j], add(0, signFlag * pValues[j])));
            }
            pValues[i] = total;
        }
        cout << pValues[k] << "\n";
    }

private:
    long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp, long long m) {
        long long result = 1;
        long long cur = base % m;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = (result * cur) % m;
            cur = (cur * cur) % m;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task task;
    task.runAlgorithm();
    return 0;
}
